title: Long-description bead exercising the modal full-text path
description: A. Problem. The board renderer silently truncates bead descriptions to 420 characters when it builds the embedded bead-data JSON map. That single map feeds both the hover flyout and the click-to-open detail modal, so the modal inherits an invisible 420-character cut and the full card ends mid-sentence with no ellipsis or marker. B. Approach. Embed the full description at build time and let the flyout keep its existing client-side 220-character ellipsized preview so the modal can render the complete text unchanged. C. Definition of Done. A bead whose description exceeds 420 characters shows its entire text in the detail modal, scrollable within the 80vh max-height, while the hover flyout still shows only the short 220-character preview with a trailing ellipsis. D. Risks. A larger embedded payload on very large boards; mitigated because the renderer stays zero-dependency and fully deterministic and the size growth is only a small single-digit percentage even on a board with several hundred beads.
